title: Sordland/Turn01/Ball Prep and Travel
description: The Rayne family prepares at home and travels to the palace for the ball.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge opened the door for me. The n..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge opened the door for me. The normally imposing palace was festooned with garish banners that nearly made it look cheerful. A line of shiny luxury sedans stretched around it.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“You know... my entire family voted..."
entries.dialogueText: “You know... my entire family voted for you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I won't let your family down, Serg..."
entries.dialogueText: “I won't let your family down, Serge.”
entries.menuText: “I won't let your family down, Serge.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm nervous myself, Franc. But I'd..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm nervous myself, Franc. But I'd feel a lot more confident with my son by my side.“
entries.menuText: “I'm nervous myself, Franc. But I'd feel a lot more confident with my son by my side.“

entries.title: Player: "“Thank you and your family. I am he..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you and your family. I am here with all of your support.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you and your family. I am here with all of your support.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“It's all right, baby. They're here..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's all right, baby. They're here to make sure nothing bad happens to your papa -- or his family."

entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“No reason to thank me, sir. You ar..."
entries.dialogueText: “No reason to thank me, sir. You are the one who sparked a glimmer of hope in us all.”

entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“I don't doubt that, sir. You are t..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't doubt that, sir. You are the one who sparked a glimmer of hope in us all.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Got that over with, Franc? Let's g..."
entries.dialogueText: “Got that over with, Franc? Let's go. The car is waiting for us."

entries.dialogueText: Suddenly Deana hugged me from behind, startling me a little. Monica had fixed her hair into an elaborate braid, woven through with ribbons.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All those years, she had stayed by..."
entries.dialogueText: All those years, she had stayed by my side. Now, we were about to begin the most challenging chapter in our lives yet.

entries.dialogueText: “Papa! Mama told me it’s time to go!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good to know, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: “Good to know, Serge."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Sure, Dad. I'm just dying to go.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sure, Dad. I'm just dying to go.”

entries.title: Franc: "“If there's even time in between al..."
entries.dialogueText: “If there's even time in between all the boring speeches."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: She shrugged.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I did, Serge. Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I did, Serge. Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Much appreciated. How are you toda..."
entries.dialogueText: “Much appreciated. How are you today, Serge?”

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“Always a pleasure to hear that.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Always a pleasure to hear that.”

entries.speaker: Franc

entries.dialogueText: “I am just as good as I can be. But today is your day, sir. I'm glad you are in charge now.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Yes. The sooner we go, the sooner..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes. The sooner we go, the sooner it'll be over, right?”

entries.menuText: “Monica, Franc, enough fussing around! Let's get a move on!”

entries.title: Player: "“This means a great deal to me.”"
entries.dialogueText: “This means a great deal to me.”
entries.menuText: “This means a great deal to me.”

entries.dialogueText: Franc tugged at the collar of his new tuxedo. He seemed ill at ease.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.speaker: Player

entries.title: Narrator: "The motorcade started moving toward..."
entries.dialogueText: The motorcade started moving towards the palace. I gazed out the window, deep in thought.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She was wearing a simple yet elegan..."
entries.dialogueText: She was wearing a simple yet elegant beige sheath dress and short heels. Her hair had been neatly pinned into a chignon, showing off the pearl earrings I had given her for our 15th anniversary.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Presidential Guard showed us th..."
entries.dialogueText: The Presidential Guard showed us the way as red and blue lights flashed around us. Serge, my driver, ushered us into our armored limousine.

entries.title: Narrator: "Monica came down the stairs."
